title: 第一卷 第23章 你可以进来了第一卷 第24章 我决定再奖励你一次
lines: 陈玄换好衣服走出来，他看向秦雪儿道：“二小姐，后厨烟大，二小姐您不用在这里等候，我做好了饭菜，先给您送过去！”
“无妨！”秦雪儿说道：“我现在饿了，第一时间就要吃！”
陈玄无奈，只能够任由他了。
而后他收拾食材，点火做菜。
不多时，整个后厨便有着一阵的香味传出，秦雪儿更是不断的咽着口水。
过去了一个时辰的样子，陈玄才做好了午饭，秦雪儿直接选择了就在后厨吃了起来。
陈玄倒也没有理会，他提着四个食盒便走了出去，他先去了大门口，林婉的贴身丫鬟小昭已经在那里等候着了。
林婉如今操持着整个将军府，每日其实都还挺忙碌的。
陈玄将林婉和柳夫人的食盒递了过去，然后和小昭闲聊了几句，便朝着白浅浅的院子走去！
而白浅浅同样不在院里，由小红接了食盒。
这让陈玄有些可惜！
他本来还想着和白浅浅商讨一下开个什么店铺的事情。
给了食盒之后，他便回到了后厨！
后厨的一张餐桌上，几个碟子空空如也，秦雪儿正一脸满足的坐在那边，看到陈玄过来，她起身道：“我恐怕不能陪你去练武场了，我得出去一趟！”
她看起来忧心忡忡的，似乎收到了什么不好的消息一般。
在加上白浅浅和林婉两人都不在，陈玄估摸着，将军府估计是出了什么事儿。
不过他倒也没有过多的去询问，而是点了点头道：“好！您忙您的！”
秦雪儿风风火火的离开了。
陈玄看了一眼不远处的赵凇，而后他便独自回到了自己的房间。
而后开始继续联系神龙九变的第一个姿势！
这一次，坚持的时间，要久了一些，但是陈玄估摸着，也就几分钟的时间而已，缓了两个时辰之后，陈玄又是会继续！
每一次练习之后恢复，他都能够清晰的感受到，自己身体强度的提升。
“也不知道如今力量能够达到什么程度。这个世界，应该有测试的方法吧！”陈玄心中盘算着。
因为晚上要接手林婉的召唤，陈玄也不敢大意，他下午练了两次，第二次的时候，他感觉自己保持姿势的时间，大概能够来到五分钟左右了。
第二次练习恢复之后，他便开始做起了晚饭！
而让陈玄诧异的是，晚饭之际，白浅浅和林婉两人依然不在，包括好吃的秦雪儿，也没有回来！
他估摸着将军府遇到的事情不算太小。
当然了，如今的他，什么都管不了！
他甚至还有着一点儿庆幸，或许晚上林婉不会来找他。
不知不觉之间，天色逐渐暗了下来。不知不觉间，便到了亥时！
夜已深，陈玄估摸着林婉大概率不会找自己了，他打算再练习一次神龙九变，就睡觉！
就在此时，敲门声传来！
“陈玄！”门外，小昭的声音响了起来道：“大夫人请你去内院！”
陈玄心中一顿，他整个人一下子就连忙起身道：“好的！”
事实上，在林婉说她后面会控制住自己，不会让陈玄有生命危险之后，对于见林婉，陈玄便是期待大于害怕了。

Chen Xuan changed his clothes and walked out. He looked at Qin Xueer and said, "Second Miss, the kitchen is very smokey. Second Miss, you don't have to wait here. I've prepared the food and will deliver it to you first!"
"It doesn't matter!" Qin Xueer said, "I'm hungry now and I want to eat as soon as possible!"
Chen Xuan had no choice but to let him go.
Then he gathered the ingredients and lit the fire to cook.
Not long after, a burst of aroma spread out from the entire kitchen, and Qin Xueer kept swallowing her saliva.
An hour passed before Chen Xuan prepared lunch. Qin Xueer directly chose to eat in the kitchen.
Chen Xuan didn't pay attention. He carried four food boxes and walked out. He went to the gate first, where Lin Wan's personal maid Xiao Zhao was already waiting there.
Lin Wan is now in charge of the entire General's Mansion, and is actually quite busy every day.
Chen Xuan handed over Lin Wan and Madam Liu's food boxes, chatted with Xiao Zhao for a few words, and then walked towards Bai Qianqian's yard!
Bai Qianqian was also not in the courtyard, so Xiaohong took the food box.
This makes Chen Xuan a little regretful!
He originally wanted to discuss with Bai Qianqian about opening a store.
After giving him the food box, he returned to the kitchen!
There were several empty plates on a dining table in the kitchen. Qin Xueer was sitting there with a satisfied look on her face. Seeing Chen Xuan coming over, she stood up and said, "I'm afraid I can't accompany you to the martial arts training ground. I have to go out!"
She looked worried, as if she had received some bad news.
In addition, Bai Qianqian and Lin Wan were not here, Chen Xuan guessed that something had happened in the General's Mansion.
However, he didn't ask too much, but nodded and said: "Okay! You are busy with your business!"
Qin Xueer left angrily.
Chen Xuan glanced at Zhao Song who was not far away, and then he returned to his room alone.
Then he continued to contact the first posture of the Nine Transformations of Shenlong!
This time, the persistence time will be longer, but Chen Xuan estimates that it will only last a few minutes. After two hours of delay, Chen Xuan will continue again!
After each recovery session, he could clearly feel the improvement in his physical strength.
"I don't know what level the power can reach now. There should be a way to test it in this world!" Chen Xuan thought in his mind.
Because he had to take over Lin Wan's summons in the evening, Chen Xuan did not dare to be careless. He practiced twice in the afternoon. During the second time, he felt that he could maintain the posture for about five minutes.
After recovering from the second practice, he started cooking dinner!
What surprised Chen Xuan was that during dinner, Bai Qianqian and Lin Wan were still not there, and the delicious Qin Xueer also didn't come back!
He estimated that the incident encountered by the General's Mansion was not too small.
Of course, he can't control anything now!
He was even a little lucky, maybe Lin Wan wouldn't come to him at night.
Unconsciously, the sky gradually darkened. Before you know it, it’s Haishi!
It was late at night, and Chen Xuan guessed that Lin Wan would most likely not look for him. He planned to practice the Nine Transformations of the Dragon again and then go to bed!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door!
"Chen Xuan!" Xiao Zhao's voice rang outside the door: "Madam, please go to the inner courtyard!"
Chen Xuan was heartbroken, and he quickly stood up and said, "Okay!"
In fact, after Lin Wan said that she would control herself later and would not put Chen Xuan's life in danger, Chen Xuan was more expecting than afraid to see Lin Wan.
